statement: theorem zero_boundaries_canary : let g₁ : ℕ → ℝ := fun _ => 1 let g₀ : ℕ → ℝ := fun _ => 0 let Q : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ := fun v n => ∑ t ∈ range n, ‖v t‖ ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ range (t + 1), ‖v i‖ ^ 2) let S : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ := fun v n => ∑ i ∈ range n, ‖v i‖ ^ 2 ((2 : ℝ) / 2 * Q g₁ 0 ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (S g₁ 0)) ∧ ((2 : ℝ) / 2 * Q g₀ 3 ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (S g₀ 3)) ∧ ((0 : ℝ) / 2 * Q g₁ 2 ≤ 0 * Real.sqrt (S g₁ 2))
